title: The empty Maintenance screen prompts the first schedule
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as an Owner/Admin, or a user with "Settings Service" enabled, on the build under test. The Maintenance Reminders feature is on for the shop (it ships behind the maintenance_reminders flag).
  2. In the left sidebar under Settings choose "Maintenance" (it sits beneath "Inspection Templates"). Schedules here belong to the location chosen in the header.
  3. The shop has no maintenance schedules yet. If any exist, archive them, or use a fresh test location so the list is empty.
custom_steps:
1. Open Settings > Maintenance with no schedules defined and read the screen.
  2. Start a new schedule and, before adding any service, try to Save it.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The empty screen shows a single call to action prompting the first schedule/service.
  • A schedule with no services cannot be saved - Save stays disabled and the empty state prompts the first service.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-3780 (Maintenance Reminders); story SV-10558 (S1, Create a maintenance schedule); Chunk 1 MR spec (Confluence 886931488), Part 1 / S1; read 29 Sep 2026. Source-verified 29 September 2026; not yet build-verified.
